title: Fox interviewed all three Rendlesham witnesses

tellings.quote: only I'm the only person to have interviewed cabansag burough and penison

plain: James Fox, a filmmaker who investigates UFO reports, says he is the only person to have interviewed all three airmen, Jim Penniston, John Burroughs and a man named Cabansag, who went into the woods near a British air base called RAF Woodbridge in 1980 after strange lights were seen, an incident also linked to their officer Charles Halt. Fox tells it from his own interviews, which would make his account of that night the only one that hears from every man who was there.
